en-US.longDescription: World of PADMAN is an incredibly carefully designed and colorful freeware fun shooter for young and young-at-heart people, created by cartoonist and illustrator ENTE and the WoP team, aka. PadWorld Entertainment. For more information about the game please visit the official World of PADMAN website. All notable changes to this game are documented in CHANGELOG.md.
